name: se
description: Refine and study ideas, turn them into clear Feature plans, deliver reviewed pull requests, maintain project knowledge, and audit active work.

interface.shortDescription: Refine ideas, run studies, plan Features, and deliver changes.
interface.longDescription: SE supports a graph-first software-delivery workflow. Learn maintains durable project knowledge, Grilling sharpens a topic or handoff through one-question-at-a-time interviews, and Study composes both before orchestrating a read-only investigation in one visible App controller or the current CLI session with optional native subagents. Idea captures proposals, while Feature uses one explicitly profiled planner plus a small transient graph to publish evidence-backed Feature Plan Sets without task-bootstrap bureaucracy. Implement Light implements explicitly selected local specs or tickets without orchestration or publication. Implement uses one visible graph orchestrator, coordinates reusable repository workers, requires bounded independent local adversarial candidate review plus exact-head hosted Codex review, and produces standalone or same-repository stacked pull requests without an execution ledger. Successful delivery releases its tiny host-local repository claim before completion. Audit observes active SE work without making changes. Implement leaves merge, deploy, release, and post-merge closure to the user.
defaultPrompt: Use $se:grilling to sharpen a topic, $se:study to investigate it, or $se:learn to preserve knowledge.
Use $se:feature to turn related requests into Feature issues and Macro Tasks without writing code.
Use $se:implement for reviewed PR delivery or $se:implement-light for local spec or ticket implementation and commit.
